request.subject: PORTRAIT:ICE_FOLK:FIGHTER

layers.text: Zoom in to a close-up portrait: redraw it as only the head and the top of the shoulders, three times bigger, so the furry head fills the whole square from edge to edge and the dark face with its eyes and fangs is in the middle; the top of the icy club shows beside the head. No legs, no feet, no belly. Keep the cream fur, the dark charcoal face, the ice crystals, thick black outline and art style the same, on a transparent background.
